restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1; W8=y0, W9=y1; W10..W15 add the fixed offsets dbce7a42, aaf3823d, 8d41a28c, 7f214e02, 6423f959, 7e640e8c. The target uses the standard IV, exactly 47 steps on both padded blocks, feed-forward, and all 256 output bits.

The walk is g(x)=walkB(state_47(M(x))) XOR q with published q=b85787773da3ade80099365e53a70b8020fff0cd54262a46d6da5870586bdf63. The output registers already hold g. A collision of g implies equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, reference_operation_cost=3484. The machine has 1024 registers. Body records cost five code bytes and one operation; other instructions cost 36 bytes.
Preprocessing is 462181911994726521 operations and includes the wasm emitter plus the complete 1641-candidate offset and selector search envelopes. preprocessing_log2 rounds upward to 46.91471.
Peak memory is 1048571 bytes; setup peaks at 670289 bytes. Every table and code field fits its declared width.

The normative embedded C source has SHA-256 a75ca7d00fc6c75c682fae38b4daa9ffe8b3303fd0f278ba255a99763877cadc; stripped wasm SHA-256 a8c077f136a77080668a2581b2e74fde2fe9e975428b7495e820a8392d574d6a; emitted SLP SHA-256 3186f22d1ae370986667d2d333a5d8213bc74dc17879105068cb76ad0712867b. The organizer executes the packaged Python byte-exact mirror; wasm accounting is participant-run.
For a uniformly random function, the bounded-restart calculation in proof Section 2 gives P_F at least 0.390000001000. H1 is the only score-critical premise and is declared, not proved.

heuristics.statement: The fixed walk succeeds at least as often as the exact bounded attempt against a lazy-sampled uniformly random 256-bit function. Fresh outputs retain collision hazard 2^-256, the first-collision law of a random mapping, independent DP density, and the same hazard after conditioning on the adaptive history.
heuristics.scope: The sha256-r47-prefix-v1 target, the 64-byte message family in proof Section 1, about 2^128 evaluations, and 256 simultaneous trails.
heuristics.extrapolation: The experiments check program correctness at width 16 and full-width projections, and compare fixed width-20 and width-22 projections with shared-function random-mapping ensembles. The fourfold state-space change checks persistence only. Extrapolation to the full attempt is by H1 only.
heuristics.limitations: H1 is a model premise about one fixed function, not a theorem. The experiments do not observe full-width collisions or estimate the claimed probability.
